criteria.text: The need for RAST/FAST/multiple-antigen allergy testing is based on findings during a complete history and physical examination
criteria.source_span: the need for such tests is based on the findings during a complete history and physical examination of the patient

criteria.text: The following tests are not medically necessary and will be denied
sub_conditions: LMRA (Lymphocyte Mitogen Response Assays) by ELISA/Act
criteria.source_span: The following tests are considered to be not medically necessary and will be denied.

criteria.text: IgG and IgG subclass antibody tests for food allergy are not covered
criteria.source_span: IgG and IgG subclass antibody tests for food allergy do not have clinical relevance, are not validated, lack sufficient quality control, and should not be performed
